race.comment: UTAH (4) has the strongest recent profile, having been beaten a long neck at this track two runs ago before finishing a close fourth as favourite last time. He is still searching for a second win, but the stable and jockey strength at this venue support the view that he gets his chance. OUTCASTER (11) is the obvious danger after consecutive thirds at this track, including a last-start effort where she beat UTAH home and was beaten just under a length at generous odds. TOORAK BLAZE (3) has to rebound, though his earlier fifth behind Charlesfort was sound and Crowther has a good record on him. MINATO (9) strips fitter third-up after hitting the frame in both runs back. Draws well for Milnes and can play a role in the finish.
